notes: Separate capacity diagnostic; never mixed with one-process stock-client results.
Every client is unmodified official redis-benchmark 8.8.3.
All six clients are started before a common file gate, checked at10ms intervals.
Aggregate throughput is total completed requests divided by the slowest stock-reported client duration; per-client CSV rates retained.
Same client processes, CPU budget, keyspace and memory caps for both servers.
Every timed attempt retained, including CPU contention; no score-based exclusions.
Wait up to2seconds for a quiet window before each timed workload; release and flag if still busy.
